visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with dark hair, wearing a white strapless top and dark leggings, sits in a bright classroom. Behind her, seven young girls in white and blue school uniforms are gathered, some raising hands and smiling. The room features a green chalkboard covered with notices and posters, wooden desks, and bright overhead fluorescent lighting. (2) The woman holds a silver flute while looking directly at the camera. A digital graphic overlay appears in the center showing 'KPOP Demon Hunters Challenge' with anime-style characters. The background girls lean in curiously, maintaining high energy and smiles in the well-lit indoor classroom environment. (3) The woman plays the flute, her fingers moving precisely on the keys. The girls behind her watch intently, then excitedly raise their hands as she finishes the musical phrase. A colorful album art overlay for 'Golden Huntress' appears. The setting remains the same, focusing on the interaction between the performer and the students. (4) Transitioning to the second song, the woman plays another melody on her flute. A girl on the right side of the frame jumps slightly in anticipation. Upon finishing, a pink-toned poster for 'Soda Pop' appears as an overlay. The background is filled with colorful classroom decorations and bright daylight through windows. (5) The woman plays a third, more complex melody on her instrument. The children look contemplative before one girl in a purple shirt gestures eagerly. An overlay for 'Your Idol' appears with a celebratory graphic. The woman smiles broadly, pointing towards the successful guesser while holding her silver flute. (6) The woman addresses the camera directly, smiling and gesturing with her hands to conclude the segment. The children behind her continue to look happy and engaged, with some waving toward the lens. The scene remains in the same bright, educational setting with posters and school furniture visible.
